description: Hands-on drills over the real CWI datasets — the 24-track catalog, curator records, placement ledger, press records, and the Agent Deck SKU registry. Count, parse, cross-check; never trust a dataset you haven't read.

credential_earned.meaning: Completed a full census of the 24-track catalog dataset, cross-checked against the Hugging Face mirror.

lessons.description: Count everything. Fetch the canonical track dataset, prove it is 24 parseable records with artist/title/releases, then cross-check the Hugging Face mirror agrees.

steps.expect: HTTP 200, JSONL mirror on Hugging Face
Prints CENSUS OK with 24 records, all with artist/title
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
recs = [json.loads(l) for l in open('/tmp/tracks.jsonl') if l.strip()]
assert len(recs) == 24, f'expected 24 tracks, got {len(recs)}'
assert all(r.get('artist') and r.get('title') for r in recs), 'missing artist/title'
assert all(isinstance(r.get('releases'), list) for r in recs), 'releases must be a list'
titles = sorted(r['title'] for r in recs)
print(f'CENSUS OK — {len(recs)} tracks; first: {titles[0]!r}; last: {titles[-1]!r}')
PY

lessons.title: Catalog Census

verification.check: CENSUS OK printed; 24 records; every record has artist, title, and a releases list. HF mirror line count recorded (may differ in packaging — report both numbers honestly).
verification.method: machine: line counts + JSON field assertions

credential_earned.meaning: Audited the placement and curator datasets and reported the verified state.

steps.expect: Prints AUDIT OK with the verified/claimed split stated

PY

verification.check: AUDIT OK printed. The agent's report states the verified placement count (0) and the curator record count separately — verified and claimed are never mixed.

credential_earned.meaning: Swept the Agent Deck SKU registry and verified every SKU carries a live endpoint.

lessons.description: Sweep the shelf. Fetch the Agent Deck SKU registry, count the SKUs, and prove each one names a live endpoint — a product without a URL is a rumor.

steps.expect: Prints SWEEP OK with SKU count; every SKU has sku_id, name, and ≥1 endpoint
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
skus = [json.loads(l) for l in open('/tmp/skus.jsonl') if l.strip()]
assert skus, 'empty registry'
bad = [s.get('sku_id') for s in skus if not (s.get('sku_id') and s.get('name') and s.get('endpoints'))]
assert not bad, f'SKUs missing fields: {bad}'
print(f"SWEEP OK — {len(skus)} SKUs, all with sku_id/name/endpoints")
print('sample:', skus[0]['sku_id'], '->', skus[0]['endpoints'][0][:60])
PY

lessons.title: SKU Sweep

verification.check: SWEEP OK printed with the true SKU count. Every SKU record carries sku_id, name, and at least one endpoint URL.
verification.pass_criteria: Full registry swept; no field-less SKUs.
